CHED EASE Scholarship Open for AY 2026-2027: Up to PHP60,000 Educational Allowance

The Commission on Higher Education's Educational Assistance for Students (EASE) program provides up to PHP60,000 per year for qualified Filipino undergraduates enrolled in CHED-recognized priority programs.

  1. Submit before the deadline. The application window closes on July 31, 2026. Incomplete or late submissions will not be processed.
